title: Playing with Gerald Wiggins again
summary: He says he plays with Wiggins and Harold Jones for Buddy Collette's dates, and that Wiggins brings him to life.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: She's studying with Dave Koonce. He's a marvelous musician. We worked together recently, he and Gerry Wiggins and I. Gerry Wiggins and I and Harold Jones worked with Buddy Collette last night. When I left home, I was really exhausted, but Gerry brings me to life, just listening to him play.
And I am with Mary Lou. We think we've got to find a room for you and Gerry to just play. A beautiful, relaxing, comfortable...
That's what it will be. Relaxed!
I think that would be so great!
Yeah, we get along. There seems to be a mutual admiration, you know. I love his playing, and he tells me he likes mine -- so that makes me float around, you know.
Well, you both have good taste.
